title: Operations-loop (the AOP record P = (R, A, D, H, F); platform-level stable-aperiodic-articulation-cell host)
description: Regime: stable-aperiodic-articulation-cell (platform-level host that composes morphisms across all four regimes; the platform's identity is articulation-committed). Per lab/.../predicated-agentic-orchestration-platform/aop-record/aop-record.md the platform is formally P = (R, A, D, H, F) where R is the predicated computer substrate (spans all four regimes internally), A is the agential-relations-system (stable-aperiodic-articulation-cell), D is the dispatch table (scott-continuous-posit-category), H is the heartbeat scheduler (platform-level), F is the federation graph (stable-aperiodic-articulation-cell). Per theory-of-predicated-agentic-orchestration-platform.md: 'The platform runs heartbeat ticks until settling, at which point it either awaits external input (a new observation) or generates the next heartbeat.' The five components are not loosely coupled: A is itself a section of R's predication-graph store; D is a sub-graph of the same store and structurally a sub-rule-system of R's closure-rule system; H is itself an entity in the store with its own scheduling-policy predications.
